basic_details.job_title: TISS Project Coordinator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Tanda has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Coordinator post on a contract basis under recruitment 2026. The engagement is initially for one year, extendable up to two years, with a specified pay of Rs. 50,000 per month. Eligible candidates holding a Masters in Social Work or Social Sciences can apply by filling out the online Google Form and uploading the requested documents. The last date for receipt of applications is 25 October 2026. The selection process consists of shortlisting of applications followed by a Written Test/ Interview.

how_to_apply: Access the online application form via the official Google Form link provided in the notification.
Fill out the required details in the Google Form accurately.
Upload your updated résumé, educational certificates, experience certificates, and other requested documents.
Submit the completed form before the last date. Note that applications submitted without completing the Google Form may not be considered.
In case of technical issues related to filling out the Google Form, reach out via email to [email protected].
important_instructions: The selected candidate will be required to join immediately. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will lead to the candidate being debarred from consideration. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and working conditions based on work experience, and age for persons holding comparable positions in a University/Research Institution of repute. The Institute reserves the right to invite persons for interview who may not have applied as per the procedure, and may choose not to fill up the advertised vacancy. The position is unreserved, but candidates belonging to reserved categories can apply. No queries or correspondence regarding call letters for interview or selection will be entertained at any stage.

content_sections.heading: TISS Project Coordinator at a Glance

rows.details: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai
Centre for Criminology and Justice, School of Social Work
Initially for one year, extendable up to two years

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Coordinator position under the NT-DNT Youth Development Project implemented across six districts of Maharashtra.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational and experience criteria specified by the institute to apply for the Project Coordinator position. Educational Qualification: Masters in Social Work or Social Sciences. Experience: 3-5 years of experience in managing projects working with marginalised communities in Maharashtra, with a special focus on legal aid, health, education, livelihood, citizenship entitlements, and training. Language Proficiency: Fluency in spoken Marathi, Hindi, and English languages, and good ability in written English language. Technical Skills: Familiarity with the use of MS-Office, emails, MIS, and the internet.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Project Coordinator will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The appointment is on a contractual basis for an initial period of one year, which is extendable up to two years.

content_sections.heading: TISS Project Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: The roles and responsibilities assigned to the Project Coordinator include: Execute project implementation plan – activities. Develop activity contents and identify resources needed for execution of the same. Ensure that reports of the activities are prepared and filed for records. Organise training sessions. Manage MIS. Documentation and record keeping. Coordination with youth fellows across 6 districts of Maharashtra. Ensure that the project delivers evidence based results – quantitative and qualitative. Update project work plans to reflect a changing environment. Articulate changes in project activities (if any) under the guidance of Project Director. Work effectively in teams as well as independently. Travel across Maharashtra and other States when necessary.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Project Coordinator
content_sections.text: Access the online application form via the official Google Form link provided in the notification. Fill out the required details in the Google Form accurately. Upload your updated résumé, educational certificates, experience certificates, and other requested documents. Submit the completed form before the last date. Note that applications submitted without completing the Google Form may not be considered. In case of technical issues related to filling out the Google Form, reach out via email to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be shortlisted based on the prescribed qualifications and requisite experience. Merely possessing the qualifications does not entitle a person to be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed over email and/or phone to appear for a Written Test/Interview (offline or online). No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview.

rows.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be required to join immediately. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will lead to the candidate being debarred from consideration. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and working conditions based on work experience, and age for persons holding comparable positions in a University/Research Institution of repute. The Institute reserves the right to invite persons for interview who may not have applied as per the procedure, and may choose not to fill up the advertised vacancy. The position is unreserved, but candidates belonging to reserved categories can apply. No queries or correspondence regarding call letters for interview or selection will be entertained at any stage.
